analysis.headline: Shares with Business Partners
analysis.quote: We may sometimes share your personal information with third parties (as described below) in order to provide or improve our services, including offering services based on your requirements.

analysis.headline: Shares within Xiaomi Group
analysis.quote: In order to successfully conduct business operations and to provide you with all the functions of our services, we may share your personal information from time to time to other Xiaomi affiliates.

analysis.headline: Shares with Mi Ecosystem
analysis.quote: Xiaomi may disclose your personal information to the Mi Ecosystem companies to provide you with and improve the existing products and services (both hardware and software) from the Mi Ecosystem companies.

analysis.headline: Tracks Your Online Activity
analysis.quote: We may collect log information related to your use, such as cookies, IP addresses.

analysis.headline: Combines Your Data
analysis.quote: We may combine this information with other information (including information across different services or devices such as computers, mobile phones and other connected devices) to provide and improve our services and content.

analysis.headline: Your Data Stored Globally
analysis.quote: Xiaomi processes and backs up personal information through a global operating and control infrastructure. Currently, Xiaomi has data centers in the United States, Germany and Singapore.

analysis.headline: Your Data Moves Globally
analysis.quote: We may also transfer your personal information to third-party service providers and business partners and your data may therefore also be transmitted to other countries or regions.

analysis.headline: Not Responsible for Partners
analysis.quote: We are not responsible for and cannot control how third parties use personal information which they collect from you.

analysis.headline: You Can Opt-out Marketing
analysis.quote: If you no longer wish to receive certain types of promotional materials, you may opt-out by the method provided in the message (such as the unsubscribe link at the bottom of the message) unless otherwise specified under applicable laws.
